name: Texas Hill Country

contains: Fredericksburg in the Texas Hill Country

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: Texas Hill Country is the state's southernmost AVA and one of the largest in the country. It contains Bell Mountain and Fredericksburg in the Texas Hill Country.
